description: This file defines a wizard for creating procurement requests within the Odoo (formerly OpenERP) framework. It includes functions for default data retrieval and procurement creation, as well as a class defining the wizard interface and workflow states.

classes.name: MakeProcurement
classes.description: Wizard class for creating procurement requests from a product form

methods.name: _get_default
methods.description: Provides default values for the procurement form based on the selected product

methods.name: make_procurement
methods.description: Creates a procurement record and triggers its confirmation workflow
